description: This file defines the JetBoyView class for an Android game, including nested classes for game events, a thread for game logic and rendering, and methods for handling game state, rendering, and JetPlayer integration. It manages game objects like asteroids, background, and player ship, and handles music via JetPlayer with mute masks and event-driven updates.

classes.name: GameEvent
classes.description: Base class for external game events, capturing event time.

classes.name: KeyGameEvent
classes.description: Represents key input events with key code, message, and up/down state.

classes.name: JetGameEvent
classes.description: Represents events from the JetPlayer, including segment, track, channel, controller, and value.

classes.name: JetBoyThread
classes.description: Main game logic thread handling rendering, game state updates, input processing, and JetPlayer events.

methods.name: initializeJetPlayer
methods.description: Sets up the JetPlayer instance, loads the jet file, and queues segments.

methods.name: doDraw
methods.description: Handles drawing the game based on current state.

methods.name: doDrawRunning
methods.description: Draws game elements during active gameplay.

methods.name: setInitialGameState
methods.description: Initializes game variables and objects at game start.

methods.name: doAsteroidAnimation
methods.description: Animates and renders asteroids and explosions.

methods.name: doDrawReady
methods.description: Draws the start screen.

methods.name: doDrawPlay
methods.description: Draws the gameplay screen.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main loop handling game updates and rendering.

methods.name: updateGameState
methods.description: Processes game events and updates game objects.

methods.name: processKeyEvent
methods.description: Handles key input events.

methods.name: updateLaser
methods.description: Updates laser firing state based on input.

methods.name: updateAsteroids
methods.description: Updates asteroid positions and handles hits.

methods.name: updateExplosions
methods.description: Animates and removes explosions.

methods.name: processJetEvent
methods.description: Handles JetPlayer events, including segment triggers and mute mask updates.

methods.name: doAsteroidCreation
methods.description: Creates new asteroid objects at random Y positions.

methods.name: setRunning
methods.description: Controls thread execution.

methods.name: getGameState
methods.description: Returns current game state.

methods.name: setGameState
methods.description: Sets game state and updates background images accordingly.

methods.name: doCountDown
methods.description: Updates game timer and sends message to UI.

methods.name: onJetEvent
methods.description: Receives JetPlayer events and queues them.
